    assert len(compute_calls) == 1, "compute should not be called on cache hit"
    assert score_v1 == score_v1_again

    # Third call with different profile v2 - should call compute again
    score_v2 = get_score(store, "user1", "job1", "v2", compute)
    assert len(compute_calls) == 2, "compute should be called for v2"
